newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht strong offshore, interbank rate eases.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht strong offshore, interbank rate eases.

text.p: The Thai baht remained strong against the dollar in offshore markets on sustained foreign demand for the currency, dealers said on Friday.
The baht was quoted offshore at 23.950/24.050 to the dollar late against 23.770/23.870 in early morning trade. In the local market, the baht was traded at 25.815/25.825 against 25.820/25.830 earlier.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 25.81 per dollar against 25.82 on Thursday.

A two-tier offshore and onshore baht market has been in place since mid-May after speculative attacks on the currency prompted the central bank to impose what dealers called capital controls to cut off baht supply to offshore players.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 140/170 satangs per dollar in offshore markets against 20/25 satangs in the domestic market.

The overnight interbank rate eased to 11.00-12.00 percent late from 15.50 in the early morning as banks began lending out surplus funds after mid-year corporate tax payment and a deadline for bank reserve requirement lapsed, dealers said.
Fund injection by the central bank through its bond repurchase window also helped boost money supply, dealers said.
